articles.title: A Record-Breaking Patch Tuesday for June 2026
articles.summary: Microsoft today released software updates to plug nearly 200 security holes across its Windows operating systems and supported software, a record number of fixes for the company's monthly Patch Tuesday.

articles.title: Microsoft June 2026 Patch Tuesday fixes 3 zero-day, 200 flaws
articles.summary: Today is Microsoft's June 2026 Patch Tuesday, with security updates for 200 flaws and three publicly disclosed zero-day vulnerabilities.

articles.title: Microsoft Defender 'RoguePlanet' zero-day grants SYSTEM privileges
articles.summary: A security researcher has released a new Microsoft Defender zero-day exploit named "RoguePlanet" just hours after Microsoft fixed two previously disclosed flaws during June 2026 Patch Tuesday.

articles.title: Ivanti: Max severity Sentry flaw allows code execution as root
articles.summary: Ivanti has patched two critical vulnerabilities in its Sentry secure mobile gateway solution, including a maximum-severity flaw that enables remote attackers to execute code with root privileges.

articles.title: Microsoft Defender RoguePlanet Zero-Day Grants SYSTEM Access on Updated Windows
articles.summary: The anonymous security researcher going by the name Chaotic Eclipse (aka Nightmare-Eclipse) has released a proof-of-concept (PoC) exploit for yet another Microsoft Defender zero-day named RoguePlanet.

articles.title: Veeam Backup & Replication RCE Flaw Lets Domain Users Run Remote Code
articles.summary: Veeam has released security patches to address a critical flaw in its Backup & Replication software that could result in remote code execution.

articles.title: New Russia-Linked GREYVIBE Group Targets Ukraine with AI-Powered Cyberattacks
articles.summary: A new, previously undocumented threat actor named GREYVIBE, believed to be Russian-speaking and aligned with Kremlin interests, has been actively targeting Ukraine since August 2025. The group is employing AI-powered cyberattacks, indicating a sophisticated and persistent campaign.

articles.title: Cisco SD-WAN Zero-Day Actively Exploited
articles.summary: Cisco has issued a warning about an unpatched zero-day vulnerability in its Catalyst SD-WAN Manager, which is being actively exploited in the wild. The flaw allows attackers to gain root privileges, posing a severe risk to network infrastructure management.

articles.title: AI Discovers 21 Zero-Days in FFmpeg; Chrome Patches Record 429 Bugs
articles.summary: An AI agent has identified 21 previously unknown zero-day vulnerabilities in FFmpeg, a widely used media processing library. Concurrently, Google released Chrome 149 with patches for an unprecedented 429 security bugs, highlighting the scale of vulnerabilities being discovered and addressed.

articles.title: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Vulnerability Actively Exploited
articles.summary: Cisco has issued a warning that a high-severity vulnerability (CVE-2026-20245) in its Catalyst SD-WAN Manager is under active exploitation. The flaw, with a CVSS score of 7.8, affects multiple deployment types, and critically, no patch is currently available.

articles.title: Chrome V8 Zero-Day Exploited in the Wild
articles.summary: A zero-day vulnerability in Chrome's V8 engine is being actively exploited in the wild. Google has released a security update to address the issue, highlighting the importance of keeping software up to date to prevent exploitation of zero-day vulnerabilities.

articles.title: CISA Orders US Agencies to Patch Check Point VPN Bug
articles.summary: CISA has given US government agencies three days to patch a critical vulnerability in Check Point's Remote Access VPN and Mobile Access deployments. The flaw is being exploited by Qilin ransomware affiliates in zero-day attacks. Prompt action is required to prevent further attacks.

articles.title: IronWorm and Miasma Worm Variants Target npm Ecosystem in Supply Chain Attacks
articles.summary: Multiple supply chain attacks have compromised the npm ecosystem, distributing a Rust-based information stealer and a self-spreading worm via over 50 malicious or poisoned legitimate packages. This widespread compromise of developer tools poses a significant risk to software integrity and the security of the software supply chain.

articles.title: One-Click GitHub Attack Steals Full OAuth Tokens via VS Code
articles.summary: A critical vulnerability in Microsoft Visual Studio Code allows attackers to steal full GitHub OAuth tokens with a single click. This exploit enables attackers to gain read and write access to a user's repositories, including private ones, posing a significant risk to developers.
